title: A base change property is tested after an fppf base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces which is fppf local on the target and stable under base change holds for a representable morphism of algebraic stacks exactly when it holds for its base change along a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 5740-5756, label lemma-check-property-after-fppf-base-change). The proof (source lines 5758-5774) chooses a cover of the base by an algebraic space and shows that both sides are equivalent to the same statement about the resulting morphism of algebraic spaces (proof lines 5758-5773). The choice of the common cover and the two applications of the covering criterion are the substance. H3.
